$comment: gosleep hooks. Stop[0] = the owner's turn-must-end-with-text guard (GSL-82) — do not weaken. Everything else = the T1 event layer (GSL-83): tools/lab/lab-log.sh normalizes each hook payload into docs/lab/events/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl. 0 tokens, no model cooperation. lab-log.sh is fail-open (always exits 0), so a broken event layer can never wedge a session. Hooks are NOT snapshotted — a file watcher reloads this file mid-session, so an edit here hits the LIVE fleet: validate with `jq .` and verify with a real run (tools/lab/hooks-verify.sh).

PreToolUse.$comment: GSL-267 GUARDED PILOT (owner decision d-2026-08-08-001, cycle 211). Both shims exit 0 INSTANTLY when GOSLEEP_WEB_QUESTIONS != '1' — so this matcher is a no-op for every session started without the pilot flag, including this orchestrator. Only a session launched with `env GOSLEEP_WEB_QUESTIONS=1 GOSLEEP_INTERNAL_SECRET=… claude …` reaches the network and long-polls gosleep-core. Timeout 3600s = the day-window agreed with the owner (configurable per-session via env GOSLEEP_HOOK_TIMEOUT_S; shim caps its own long-poll at that value). Widening to all sessions requires an explicit owner command — do NOT drop the guard without one. Rollback: `git revert` of this commit (or delete this PreToolUse block; the file watcher will unload it live). AskUserQuestion shim body: GSL-275. PermissionRequest wiring: NOT here — see the top-level `PermissionRequest` event below (GSL-304 real-session fix). The old PreToolUse{matcher:'PermissionRequest'} entry never fired (matcher matches on tool_name, and no tool is literally named 'PermissionRequest' — GSL-297 runs/01 v9 evidence).

PermissionRequest.$comment: GSL-304 real-event wiring. Claude Code fires PermissionRequest exactly when a tool call needs a permission decision (i.e. when the TUI modal would otherwise render). This event is a peer of PreToolUse — NOT a matcher value on it. Matcher matches on tool_name; `.*` intercepts every prompting tool. The shim is guarded on GOSLEEP_WEB_QUESTIONS=1 (unchanged since GSL-284/GSL-267): every non-pilot session hits `exit 0` in < 1 ms and the TUI modal renders as before. The shim's stdout returns hookSpecificOutput.decision.behavior='allow'|'deny' — the CC-documented shape for this event, distinct from PreToolUse's `permissionDecision`. Widening to all sessions still requires an owner command (owner decision d-2026-08-08-001). Rollback: delete this block; file watcher unloads live.

PostToolUse.$comment: ONE hook, no `if`. The `if` field exists (v2.1.85+) and would pre-filter before spawning the process — but a real run on 2.1.207 showed two `if` rules under one matcher BOTH firing on the same call (one action -> two events), and `Bash(git *)` matching a command that only MENTIONED git inside a quoted string. Routing by sub-command prefix inside lab-log.sh is the version we can prove correct; the cost is one process spawn per Bash call.

Second command = GSL-198: the debounce trigger from the ORIGINAL design (05-lab-ui-mobile-autonomy.md:184 — 'a PostToolUse async hook debounced on writes to docs/lab/') that fell out at implementation. The shim arms a background waiter and exits instantly; the chronicler runs once per quiet window. Kill switch: GOSLEEP_DEBOUNCE_DISABLE=1. Runbook: docs/runbooks/tick-engine.md.
